## HVMC Security Operations
Horizon Valley Medical Center · centralised logging (Activity Log, NSG, Bastion, ePHI storage, VNet flow logs), Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel in **HVMC-SecOps-LAW**. Author: Sabitha S Karanavar.

content.query: union withsource=LogTable * | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated) by LogTable | order by Events desc
content.title: Log sources reporting (events per table)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where OperationNameValue has 'ActivityLogAlerts/Activated'
| extend Rule = tostring(split(_ResourceId, '/')[-1]) | summarize Fired = count() by Rule | order by Fired desc
content.title: Security alerts fired (Azure Monitor activity-log alerts)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), CategoryValue
content.title: Control-plane activity per hour by category
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where ActivityStatusValue in~ ('Success','Succeeded')
| extend Kind = case(
    OperationNameValue has 'securityRules', 'Firewall (NSG) rule change',
    OperationNameValue has 'roleAssignments', 'Role assignment change',
    OperationNameValue has 'listKeys' or OperationNameValue has 'regenerateKey', 'Storage key access',
    OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/WRITE', 'Storage configuration change',
    OperationNameValue has 'publicIPAddresses/write', 'Public IP created',
    OperationNameValue has 'diagnosticSettings/delete' or OperationNameValue has 'flowLogs/delete', 'Logging disabled',
    OperationNameValue has 'Microsoft.Security/pricings', 'Defender plan change', '')
| where isnotempty(Kind) | summarize Count = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Kind | order by Count desc
content.title: Security-relevant changes
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(Caller)
| summarize Operations = count(), Failed = countif(ActivityStatusValue in~ ('Failure','Failed')) by Caller | top 10 by Operations
content.title: Who is making changes
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident, (datatable(IncidentNumber:int, Severity:string, Status:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where isnotempty(Severity)
| summarize Incidents = count() by Severity, Status
content.title: Sentinel incidents by severity and status
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert, (datatable(AlertName:string, AlertSeverity:string, ProductName:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(AlertName) | summarize Alerts = count() by AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProductName
content.title: Defender for Cloud alerts
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true StorageBlobLogs, (datatable(OperationName:string, CallerIpAddress:string, StatusText:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(OperationName)
| summarize Requests = count(), DistinctCallers = dcount(CallerIpAddress), Failures = countif(StatusText != 'Success') by OperationName
content.title: ePHI storage access (hvmcehrstorage blob operations)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true NTANetAnalytics, (datatable(FlowStatus:string, FlowDirection:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(FlowStatus) | summarize Flows = count() by FlowStatus, FlowDirection
content.title: Network flows (VNet flow logs / Traffic Analytics)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range

content.query: Usage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DataType
content.title: Log ingestion vs 0.5 GB/day cap (MB per day)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range
